name: Custom Super Hero
original_name: カスタムスーパーヒーロー
source:
In Custom Hero, you play as an Evil Organization making experiments on a veteran superhero they have freshly captured.

[From [url=https://satyroom.itch.io/customherobonus-scene]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在“自定义英雄”中，你扮演一个邪恶组织，对他们刚刚捕获的资深超级英雄进行实验。

[来自[url=https://satyroom.itch.io/customherobonus-scene]Itch.io[/url]]
